input.title: Men's Grandpa – Papa: Where Dad Got His Jokes Crewneck Sweatshirt
input.descriptionHtml:
The Story

A jolly grandfather in a cardigan and reading glasses sits back in a worn armchair, laughing at his own joke with a slipper slipping off his foot, and the sweatshirt says PAPA, WHERE DAD GOT HIS JOKES. This papa sweatshirt is for the grandpa whose grandkids groan and laugh at holiday dinners, birthday mornings and ball games.

The print is a 1950s cartoon scene: a white-haired man with a neat white mustache, round glasses, a mustard cardigan and blue slacks, leaning back in a red overstuffed armchair with one house slipper dangling from his foot. PAPA is in mustard Western-style capitals above, with WHERE DAD GOT in slab capitals and HIS JOKES. in red below.

Wear it to the holiday table, a birthday breakfast or the sideline at the grandkids' games, and give it to the grandpa who has never told a joke only once. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Classic unisex crewneck sweatshirt fit
  • 50% cotton, 50% polyester fleece
  • Fabric weight: 8 oz/yd²
  • Ribbed crew neck, cuffs and waistband; no hood, no pockets
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • 2 colors: Sand, Navy

Questions

What is the Papa: Where Dad Got His Jokes sweatshirt?
It is a crewneck sweatshirt from Graphic Tees Co. showing a laughing grandpa in an armchair, lettered PAPA, WHERE DAD GOT HIS JOKES. It is a Gildan 18000 in 8 oz cotton-poly fleece, with no hood and no pockets, so it works as an easy layer.

How does the crewneck sweatshirt fit?
This Graphic Tees Co. crewneck is a classic unisex fit in sizes S through 3XL with a ribbed collar, cuffs and waistband. Order your usual size for a regular fit or size up for a roomier layer over a tee. If the size is off, the first exchange is free.

How warm is it and how do I wash it?
The sweatshirt is 50% cotton and 50% polyester fleece at 8 oz, a solid layer for a fall football game or a chilly porch. Wash it inside out in cold water and tumble dry low. That keeps the mustard, red and navy inks from fading and the fleece soft.

Is it a good gift for Papa from the grandkids?
Yes. It suits the papa who tells the same joke twice and loves it, and it works as a Christmas or birthday gift from the grandkids, or from Dad owning the joke. From Graphic Tees Co. it costs $34.99 in Sand and Navy, and the free size exchange makes it safe to give.

Can I get it by Christmas?
Order by about December 8 and your Graphic Tees Co. papa sweatshirt should arrive before Christmas. Each sweatshirt is printed the day you order it, so ship times vary a little by location. Orders over $45 ship free, and the free size exchange covers a wrong guess.
